eventDetail.scope: The conference scope includes the following tracks, all of which fall within IEEE’s core technical domains: Components, Circuits, Devices & Systems: aligned with IEEE fields such as circuits and systems, electronics, and device technologies. Computing & Processing (Hardware/Software): aligned with computer engineering, embedded systems, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence applications, and software engineering. General Topics for Engineers (Mathematics, Science, and Engineering Applications): focused on applied mathematics and computational science supporting engineering systems. Robotics and Control Systems: aligned with control systems engineering, automation, intelligent systems, and mechatronics Signal Processing & Analysis: aligned with digital signal processing, image processing, communication systems, and data-driven signal analytics.
